title: Sharp Gaussian Approximation for Q-Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.19850v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Gaussian approximation provides a foundation for online statistical inference in reinforcement learning. We establish sharp non-asymptotic Gaussian approximation rates in Wasserstein distance for asynchronous Q-learning with Polyak-Ruppert averaging. We prove an upper bound of $\widetilde{O}(n^{-1/4})$, where $n$ is the number of iterations, together with a matching lower bound up to logarithmic factors. Q-learning is more challenging to analyze than linear stochastic approximation due to the nonlinearity of the Bellman operator. Asynchronous updates introduce further challenges due to Markovian noise. Our analysis separates the errors from Bellman nonlinearity, Markovian noise, and the finite-sample covariance discrepancy. In particular, we show that Markovian noise induces an unavoidable bias even when the Bellman operator is linear. translated_abstract: 高斯逼近为强化学习中的在线统计推断提供了基础。我们为采用Polyak-Ruppert平均的异步Q-学习建立了Wasserstein距离下的精确非渐近高斯逼近速率。我们证明了$\widetilde{O}(n^{-1/4})$的上界，其中$n$为迭代次数，并同时给出了在对数因子意义下与之匹配的下界。由于Bellman算子的非线性，Q-学习比线性随机逼近更难分析；而异步更新则因马尔可夫噪声带来了进一步的挑战。我们的分析将Bellman非线性、马尔可夫噪声以及有限样本协方差偏差这三类误差分离开来。特别地，我们证明即使Bellman算子是线性的，马尔可夫噪声也会引入不可避免的偏差。该偏差与协方差偏差之间的权衡决定了收敛速率。（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文为带Polyak-Ruppert平均的异步Q-学习在Wasserstein距离下建立了$\widetilde{O}(n^{-1/4})$的精确非渐近高斯逼近速率及匹配下界，并揭示了马尔可夫噪声偏差与有限样本协方差偏差之间的权衡如何决定收敛速率。
